issues.where: Close-up globe, especially the lower cloud belts and upper-right quadrant (image-06.png crops C and I; image-08.png crops U and V)
issues.what: Fine cloud detail smears into long directional streaks and soft patches, while the background stars stay much crisper.
issues.fix: Render the close-up with higher-resolution cloud detail and dial back directional blur until small eddies hold up across the disk.

issues.where: Crops K, L and P, in the cream and ochre belts above the Great Red Spot
issues.what: Bright ridges and dark outlines make the cloud bands look embossed and glossy, like solid relief rather than gas.
issues.fix: Reduce small-scale relief and harsh reflection; preserve the swirls with softer, layered cloud shading.

issues.where: Crop H, yellow moon at the right of the close-up
issues.what: The moon's face and upper edge are visibly smeared, leaving little readable surface detail even though nearby stars are sharp.
issues.fix: Use a sharper moon texture and reduce object blur enough to retain the rim and surface markings.

issues.where: Crop O, immediately to the right of the moon
issues.what: The long, near-black shadow appears attached to the moon and reads like a drop shadow pasted onto the cloud deck.
issues.fix: Compute the shadow separately on the curved cloud deck and use a finite light source for the penumbra rather than a uniform oval.

issues.where: Crops J and O, sunlit left limb
issues.what: The broad glow washes several cloud bands into nearly featureless white just inside the limb.
issues.fix: Lower the bloom and roll off the brightest tones more gently so band structure remains visible up to the edge.

issues.where: terminator across the right half of the globe (crops C, L, Q)
issues.what: the day-night falloff is a near-vertical screen-space gradient rather than a curve following the sphere, so the night side reads as a flat dark overlay and the globe looks flat
issues.fix: compute the terminator from a spherical lighting model so the shadow edge bends with the limb, with a narrow warm twilight band

issues.where: lower third and lower right of the cloud deck (crops D, E, I, S-W)
issues.what: the cloud surface turns into smeared, brushstroke-like swirls with no fine structure at native size; it looks painted or airbrushed rather than like a cloud field
issues.fix: add high-frequency cloud detail and small convective cells in the shadowed region and lift the shadows slightly so the detail can be read

issues.what: the moon is a smooth, plastic-looking ball with a soft, painted texture and no crisp surface detail; its edge against the planet is slightly soft and haloed
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution moon texture with sharp volcanic surface detail and a hard, airless limb

issues.where: below the planet's lower right limb (crops E, V)
issues.what: a blue-grey haze patch sits in the sky beneath the night side, like a stray cloud or a glow leaking past the planet's edge
issues.fix: remove the haze, or confine any background nebula so it does not hug the planet outline

issues.where: blue glows in the lower centre (crops E, U)
issues.what: the blue lightning glows look like clumped glitter blobs with a hazy halo rather than lightning flashes lighting up the cloud
issues.fix: shape the glows as diffuse flashes inside the clouds, lighting nearby cloud tops, without sparkle points

issues.where: Great Red Spot and banded detail (crops A, P)
issues.what: band turbulence is soft and slightly painterly at native size; the GRS spiral looks like a brush swirl
issues.fix: sharpen the band texture and add fine filamentary eddies

issues.where: sunlit limb, upper left (crops B, J)
issues.what: the bright limb is blown out into a flat white glow with no detail
issues.fix: pull back the exposure and the bloom on the sunlit limb
